summary.text: Timoria McQueen Saba is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 68 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a maternal health advocate, speaker and policy strategist.

paragraphs.text: Timoria McQueen Saba earned a bachelor's degree from William James College, according to Ballotpedia.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she moved from a career as a professional makeup artist into health advocacy after a life-threatening postpartum hemorrhage in 2010, and that she began sharing her story publicly in 2012.

She said she was appointed to the Massachusetts Special Commission on Postpartum Depression and co-authored the Act to Reduce Inequities in Maternal Health, which established the state's Racial Inequities in Maternal Health Commission.

She also listed leadership roles with the Perinatal-Neonatal Quality Improvement Network of Massachusetts, the state's Title V Maternal and Child Health Block Grant Advisory Committee, and Postpartum Support International.
McQueen Saba wrote that she would advocate for fully funded public schools, work on affordability, work to eliminate food insecurity, protect voting rights and safeguard the environment.
